title: Scheduled report delivery
summary: Teams schedule a daily report and can inspect the outcome of each delivery.

nodes.label: Schedule API
nodes.summary: Stores a team's delivery time, time zone and destination.
nodes.detail: Reject invalid time zones and let a team pause future deliveries.

nodes.label: Run planner
nodes.summary: Creates a pending run when a schedule comes due.
nodes.detail: Use the schedule ID and local report date as the run key so planner retries cannot enqueue duplicate runs.

nodes.label: Run ledger
nodes.summary: Tracks pending, claimed, delivered and failed runs.
nodes.detail: Expose the latest outcome and failure reason to the owning team. Expired claims become eligible for retry.

nodes.label: Delivery worker
nodes.summary: Claims a pending run, renders the report and sends it.
nodes.detail: Pass the run key to the delivery provider for idempotency. Record success or the failure reason in the ledger.
